title: ArchKeel Studio API 1.1: GET /api/v1/state and GET /api/v1/graph
description: AD-290. The two answers of one Studio server. The API is read-only. Version 1.1 adds the graph; the state is the one of 1.0 with the new version.

explore.description: The explore run that makes the snapshot in the cache folder.

contract.description: What archkeel.toml at the root gives: no file, a file that does not load, or a loaded file.

notes.description: The diagnostics of a failed run; else empty.

graph.title: GET /api/v1/graph
graph.description: The measured call graph of the snapshot. `graph` is null until `explore` is done. Every row is an array; a number that names a row of another list is its index.

components_from.description: Where the components come from: the contract at the root, or the top-level packages of the explore layout. A contract that does not load gives the layout.

components.description: [id, responsibility]. The id is a label of the contract, else a top-level package of the explore layout, else "(unowned)". The responsibility is the first one of the contract; else empty.

modules.description: [name, file, component, relative]. component indexes components; relative is the name below the shared prefix of the component.

symbols.description: [module, name, line, kind, text, unknown, outside]. module indexes modules; name is the qualified name below the module; text is the first source line, 80 characters at most; unknown is the true number of unresolved calls of the function (the unknown list keeps the first 4); outside counts the resolved or partly resolved calls whose targets lie outside the scan.

edges.description: [source, target, partial, line, site]. source and target index symbols. false = resolved (proven); true = partially resolved (claim). line is the line of the call in the file of the source. site numbers the call sites: a partly resolved call can give two edges with one site, so count sites, not edges.

unknown.description: [symbol, expression, reason, line]. A sample of the calls that the analysis cannot resolve: the first 4 for each symbol; the symbol row holds the true number.
